I tested the Laziest TikTok Snack recipes to see if they're actually lazy and actually worth making... Let's find out!

Let me know what viral recipes I should try next 😃

The TikTok/Instagram recipes I reviewed are below:
S'mores wrap by Chloeandleox
Lazy girl french toast by Foodfinduae
Pizza fries by Hediye_tepehan
Frozen chocolate raspberries by Lacuisinedekam
Cheesy honey butter toast by Nourishing
Reese's cookie pie by Snackattackchef
S'mores toast by Thefastfoodie.tv

Give these amazing creators a follow and check out their videos on TikTok ❤️

If you're new here, I'm Eloise a 4 x best-selling cookbook author and recipe creator.

Find me on Instagram: @eloisehead @fitwaffle @fitwafflekitchen
